verses.text: The LORD is my shepherd, so I will not be in need.
He lets me lie down and rest in green fields. He leads me beside calm, quiet waters.
He refreshes my soul. He leads me on the paths of what is right, so that his name is honoured.
Even if I walk through a valley as dark as death, I will not fear any harm, because you are with me. Your shepherd's rod and staff give me comfort.
You set a table for me while my enemies look on. You pour oil on my head as a sign of welcome. My cup is full to overflowing.
I am sure that your goodness and your faithful love will stay with me every day of my life. And I will live in the house of the LORD for ever.
